def gp(k, tr, te, Y, floor):
    from scipy.linalg import cho_factor
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    from scipy.optimize import minimize
    n = len(tr)
    A = k[:, tr[:, None], tr]
    B = k[:, te[:, None], tr]
    scale = np.diagonal(A, axis1=1, axis2=2).mean(1)
    A = A / scale[:, None, None]
    B = B / scale[:, None, None]
    I = np.eye(n)
    A = np.concatenate([A, I[None]])
    sd = Y[tr].std()
    Yt = Y[tr] / sd

    def obj(p, ret=False):
        w = np.exp(p)
        cf = cho_factor(np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', w, A))
        al = cho_solve(cf, Yt)
        if ret:
            return sd * np.einsum('i,ijk,k->j', w[:-1], B, al)
        Q = cho_solve(cf, I) - np.outer(al, al)
        return (0.5 * Yt @ al + np.log(np.diag(cf[0])).sum(), 0.5 * w * np.einsum('ijk,jk->i', A, Q))
    p = minimize(obj, np.r_[np.zeros(len(k)) - 2, -7], jac=True, method='L-BFGS-B', bounds=[(-15, 6)] * len(k) + [(np.log(floor / sd ** 2), 1)]).x
    return obj(p, True)
